Your square version is ready to download (link works for 24 hours):

What I asked for:
- Your photo is wide (about 1024×384) and the shoe takes up about 500 px of that width. A square cut from the middle would lose part of the shoe, so I didn't do that.
- The new image is a 1:1 square, 640 px, centred on the shoe with a margin all round. The empty grey panel on the right is gone. The wall and floor are extended plainly above and below to fill the square.

- It used 5 credits with the free flux-2-klein model.

The AI editor redraws the image, so small details like stitching, laces or the edge of the sole can come out slightly different. Compare it with your original, especially at the heel, the toe and the bottom of the sole.

If anything is cut off or changed, tell me and I'll run it again. If you need the shoe pixel-for-pixel identical, a basic image editor is the safest option. Crop your photo to roughly the left 640 px (this removes the grey panel). Then add plain canvas above and below until it's 640×640.
